items.q: Do I need experience to start?
items.a: No. Beginners start with Basic Computer Operations or IT Essentials. An adviser will help you choose.

items.q: Is the Cisco exam included in the fee?
items.a: No. The Cisco exam voucher is paid separately. Ask an adviser for the current price.

items.q: Who awards the OND and HND?
items.a: Bellarks Polytechnic awards the national diplomas. Netprox teaches them at our Lakowe study centre.

items.q: When do OND and HND admissions open?
items.a: Admissions open once final NBTE approval is in place. Register your interest and we will contact you.

items.q: Are classes online or in person?
items.a: Both. You can learn in person at our Lakowe study centre or online. Ask an adviser about the options for your course.
We run weekday and weekend classes. An adviser will confirm the schedule for your course.
Yes. You can pay your course fee in instalments. Ask an adviser about the payment plan for your course.
Cisco courses prepare you for Cisco certification exams. Career courses earn a Netprox Certificate of Completion. OND and HND graduates receive their diploma from Bellarks Polytechnic.
